response.explanation: src/presentation/server.ts is the process entry point. On line 1 it imports createGateways from the persistence layer, and on line 5 it passes the result straight into buildApp(createGateways()). It does not query data itself. It acts as a composition root: it builds the persistence gateways, hands them to the app, and then starts the daily weather check (lines 9-11) and the HTTP listener (line 13). FF-S03 flags this because a presentation-layer file imports a persistence-layer module directly and skips the layers in between. That breaks the strict layering the rule enforces, whatever the reason for the import. No docs, ADRs or comments were provided that call this file a sanctioned composition root or exempt it from layering. The only nearby comment (line 7) is about the forecast schedule. The usual fix is to move the wiring into a dedicated bootstrap or composition module outside the presentation layer, or to have an intermediate layer expose the gateway factory. Either way, presentation would no longer reference persistence directly.
